metas.name: Raakshasa
metas.description: SI Hanmappa investigates a trail of crocodile attacks on the banks of the Malaprabha. While villagers blame them on ancient myths, the discovery of bloodied remains changes the course of the case.

metas.name: Ayyana Mane
metas.description: Jaaji arrives at her marital home on her wedding day, only to witness her father-in-law’s sudden death. As she discovers more chilling secrets, Jaaji must find a way to survive in the house
